**Finding: deviation (critical) — § 21.1**

The cap in § 21.1 is set at Fees "actually paid in the one month preceding the event, without exception." Two problems:

1. **Basis far too low.** One month of Fees — with "Fees" (§ 1.5) excluding taxes, expenses, credits and implementation charges — falls below even our walk-away threshold of six months' fees, and is grossly out of step with the risk profile (Vendor carries USD 5m cyber cover under § 18.1).
2. **"Without exception" swallows the carve-outs.** It overrides the Excluded Claims regime in § 21.3, pulling indemnities, confidentiality, data-protection/security breaches, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement inside the cap.

The cap is already mutual, and §§ 21.2–21.4 (consequential-damages exclusion, Excluded Claims definition, payment obligations not "damages") meet the playbook, so the redline is confined to § 21.1: cap set at the greater of 12 months' Fees paid or payable and USD 1,000,000, with Excluded Claims expressly outside the limitation. Redline validated (ok:true) and finding submitted.
